bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = {
    optimize_memory
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_agri_drone }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 2 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_agri_drone_food value > 0 }
                }
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 3 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_agri_drone_alloys value > 0 }
                }
            }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_agri_drone value > bca_jr_best_wf }
        }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_agri_drone }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_alien_hunter }

bca_jr_fill_current_slot = {
    optimize_memory
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_agri_drone }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 2 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_agri_drone_food value > 0 }
                }
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 3 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_agri_drone_alloys value > 0 }
                }
            }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_agri_drone value = bca_jr_best_wf }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = $SLOT_NUM$ }
        }
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_job_agri_drone
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_mapped
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_agri_drone
        add_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_alien_hunter }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 2 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_alien_hunter_food value > 0 }
                }
            }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_alien_hunter value = bca_jr_best_wf }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = $SLOT_NUM$ }
        }
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_job_alien_hunter
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_mapped
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_alien_hunter
        add_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_archivist }

                AND = {

            OR = {
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 2 }

            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_peasant value = bca_jr_best_wf }

        }
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_job_peasant

            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = $SLOT_NUM$ }
        }
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_job_treasure_gatherer
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_mapped
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_treasure_gatherer
        add_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_treasure_gatherer_gestalt }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 0 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_energy value > 0 }
                }
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 1 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_minerals value > 0 }
                }
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 6 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_unity value > 0 }
                }
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 8 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_society_research value > 0 }
                }
            }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_treasure_gatherer_gestalt value = bca_jr_best_wf }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = $SLOT_NUM$ }
        }
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_job_treasure_gatherer_gestalt
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_mapped
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_treasure_gatherer_gestalt
        add_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_turtle_miner_gestalt }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 1 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_turtle_miner_gestalt_minerals value > 0 }
                }
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 2 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_turtle_miner_gestalt_food value > 0 }
                }
            }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_turtle_miner_gestalt value = bca_jr_best_wf }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = $SLOT_NUM$ }
        }
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_job_turtle_miner_gestalt
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_mapped
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_turtle_miner_gestalt
        add_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_wrangler }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 2 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_wrangler_food value > 0 }
                }
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 6 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_wrangler_unity value > 0 }
                }
                AND = {
                    check_variable = { which = bca_jr_gui_category value = 8 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_output_wrangler_society_research value > 0 }
                }
            }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_wrangler value = bca_jr_best_wf }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = $SLOT_NUM$ }
        }
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_job_wrangler
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_mapped
        set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_wrangler
        add_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }
    }
}

bca_jr_refresh_slot_data = {
    optimize_memory
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }

    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s1 SLOT_NUM = 1 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s2 SLOT_NUM = 2 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s3 SLOT_NUM = 3 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s4 SLOT_NUM = 4 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s5 SLOT_NUM = 5 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s6 SLOT_NUM = 6 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s7 SLOT_NUM = 7 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s8 SLOT_NUM = 8 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s9 SLOT_NUM = 9 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s10 SLOT_NUM = 10 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s11 SLOT_NUM = 11 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s12 SLOT_NUM = 12 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s13 SLOT_NUM = 13 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s14 SLOT_NUM = 14 }
    }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_wf value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s15 SLOT_NUM = 15 }
    }

    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_display_count value = bca_jr_fill_idx }
    subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_display_count value = 1 }
    clear_variable = bca_jr_fill_idx
    clear_variable = bca_jr_best_wf
}
